claim: *Processing one document in DocAble.* A user submits a document, creating a job that tracks its processing. The work may be divided into chunks and processed by workers using specialized services for generation, rendering, optical character recognition (OCR), and document-format processing. The resulting changes are reassembled and validated, and the remediated document is returned with evidence.

topology.description: Processing fork/join; workers call specialist services while repaired pieces rejoin.

required_terms: Specialized services Generation · render · OCR Document / format machinery
bw_encoding: Black outlines and arrows; white nodes; sparse 3–7% gray groups. Every non-solid relation is locally labeled; no distinction depends on color.
redesign: Native semantic redraw; colors replaced by labeled relations and line conventions.
alt: A submitted document creates a tracked job, which splits into chunks processed by workers. Workers call generation, rendering, OCR and document-format services. Repaired pieces rejoin, are validated and return as a remediated document with evidence of consequential changes. The fork and join distinguish concurrent work from its shared job. The candidate uses black lines, white backgrounds and sparse gray; meaning does not depend on color.
